AA_banks: Two isolated full copies of the authenticated source-only baseline warm bank; baseline Cargo in both; private registry cache absent.
cache: Candidate-only registry cache absent in both baseline A/A banks at every boundary.
output_gate: Fresh per-host, per-label singleton exact uv check rmeta rules and complete ordinary diagnostics; no inherited rlib/ELF or metadata equivalence exceptions. Preserve raw outputs/exit before decoder; complete child and freshness/restoration gates.
public_replay_limit: Numerical replay and hash/typed-sample joins are portable; complete private host/output admission is summarized and digest-bound, not independently reconstructible from this small addendum.
quietness: Original occupancy checks retained before and after each sample; three maintenance services and apt locks/timers checked.
raw_scope: Public raw files contain only the original unit and integer elapsed_ns. Private command environments, paths, process inventories, traces and full output copies are excluded; their authenticated custody digests are retained in provenance.json.
restoration: Both full 16-sample blocks passed source/runtime/original-Cargo/bank/freshness and positive descendant-quiescence checks. All records are retained privately.
source_edit: Use the exact accepted donor fixture: append a deterministic ordinary non-doc comment, warm its state=before form, then change it to state=after_. The strings have equal length and five changed bytes. All Rust tokens and source positions remain unchanged. Restore the original source afterward; no production uv change.
timer_boundary: perf_counter_ns immediately before Popen through ordinary Cargo wait; all descendants must positively drain before moving or reusing any path
